parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, deciding which drone flies along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I need help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. Drones fly on their own autopilots while people on the ground supervise, and nobody steers a drone with a stick through this service.
